name: cyber-universe
description: Cyber Universe — AI Life Simulation Platform (pixel world + AI residents)

scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=.deps:. python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=.deps:. python3 -m pytest tests -v
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=.deps:. python3 -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=.deps:. python3 -m alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.android:sync: pnpm --filter @cyber-universe/web build && pnpm --filter @cyber-universe/android exec cap sync android
